Patte.g: mukhavaṭṭito heṭṭhā dvaṅgulamattokāsato paṭṭhāya yattha katthaci chiddaṁ hoti.
taṁ nāgaṁ nihatatejaṁ dhammadesanāya santappetvā saraṇasīlāni datvā sakalarattiṁ bhagavantaṁ payirupāsitvā ṭhitaṁ jaṭilānaṁ dassanatthaṁ patte pakkhipi, na ahituṇḍiko viya balakkārenāti veditabbaṁ.

patte.g: pubbe ujukaṁ heṭṭhāmukhaṁ patiṭṭhita-arassa bhūmippadesaṁ2 puna tasmiṁ yeva are parivattetvā heṭṭhāmukhabhāvena sampatte, paṭhamaṁ bhūmiyaṁ patiṭṭhitanemippadese parivattetvā puna bhūmiyaṁ patiṭṭhiteti vuttaṁ hoti.
ettha “yathā paṭhamataraṁ patitatheve doso natthi, tathā ākiritvā apanentānaṁ pacchā patitathevepi abhihaṭattā nevatthi doso”ti vadanti.

patte.l: Yaṁ sāmaṇerassa patte patati -pa- paṭiggahaṇaṁ na vijahatī
patte.g: ettha punappunaṁ gaṇhantassa attano patte pakkhittameva “attano santakan”ti sanniṭṭhānakaraṇato hatthagataṁ paṭiggahaṇaṁ na vijahati, paricchinditvā dinnaṁ pana gaṇhantassa gahaṇasamayeyeva “attano santakan”ti sanniṭṭhānassa katattā hatthagataṁ paṭiggahaṇaṁ vijahati.
paṭhamaṁ bhūmiyaṁ patiṭṭhitanemippadese parivattetvā puna bhūmiyaṁ patiṭṭhiteti attho.
ekamekaṁ viññāpentā bahū bhikkhū bahū patte viññāpenti, bahū vā bhikkhū patte viññāpentīti attho.
puna taṁ ṭhānaṁ parivaṭṭetvā āgate aññasmiṁ are”ti likhitaṁ.
mocanakammakkhamatāya kammaniyataṁ patte, ajjhattarūpādīsu upakkamārahabhāvaṁ patteti attho.

patte.g: iminā upāsakena satthu pariccattabhāvaṁ, tattha satthuno ca aparisaṅkataṁ dasseti.

pattena.g: anatthikampi pattena bhikkhuṁ evaṁ vadāpento bhagavā sotthiyā mantapadavasena vadāpesi.
ettha bhikkhubhāvasāmaññassa ūnapañcabandhanapattabhāvo pakāro, taṁ bhikkhu āpanno, tassa patto lakkhaṇaṁ.
na kālantarena pattena, kālaṁ anatikkamitvāva pattenāti attho.
